herbinfo.title: Ruzivo rwemishonga yemasora
herbinfo.lead: Marekodhi kubva kudatabase yemishonga yeDeepWeed. Kutungamirira chete — tevera zvakanyorwa pachigadzirwa nguva dzose.
herbinfo.dataNote: Ruzivo rwezvigadzirwa runobva mudatabase uye runoratidzwa muChirungu.
res.title: Kudzivirira kuramba kwemishonga yemasora
res.lead: Mitemo yakajairika yekuchengetedza inononotsa kuramba kwemishonga. Kuti uwane zano rakananga chirimwa nenzvimbo yako, taura nenyanzvi yekurima kana mutambi weAgritex.
res.d1: Kushandisa mhando imwe yemushonga gore rimwe nerimwe kunosarudza masora anoramba. Chinjanisa mhando, uye chinjanisa zvirimwa kana zvichibvira.
res.d2: Sanganisa mishonga nekurima, mulch, kutenderera kwezvirimwa, mbeu yakachena nekusakura nemaoko kuti nzira imwe isaite basa rese.
res.d3: Kushandisa mushonga mushoma kana kupfapfaidza masora akakura kunobvumira akasara kuita mbeu. Tevera zvakanyorwa pachigadzirwa pahuwandu nenhanho yekukura.
res.d4: Famba mumunda mavhiki 1–3 mushure mekushandisa. Masora asara pakati peakafa anogona kuratidza kuramba, kwete kupfapfaidza zvisina kunaka.
res.d5: Chenesa michina uchibva kumunda umwe uchienda kune mumwe, uye bvisa masora asara asati ava nembeu.
res.d6: Nyora chakapfapfaidzwa, kupi uye rini. Marekodhi anoita kuti kuramba kuoneke uye anobatsira vaduki kukubatsira.
